meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 当用户问起某条 Tip 提示时，Claude 会先查询 senpi 的实时提示列表，并检查该用户当前实际能看到哪些提示，再阅读相关功能代码核实，最后用用户使用的语言给出深入、具体的原理解释，注明所查看的代码文件路径。
howto.when: 当用户询问某条 Tip 提示、问提示含义或功能原理，或直接说“give-me-tips”等时触发。

say.text: 请解释一下刚才出现的 Tip: line 是什么意思？
say.note: Claude 会先查列表再给出解释。

say.text: 我现在能看到哪些提示？
say.note: Claude 会检查你的设置并列出可见提示。

say.text: 这个提示背后的机制具体是怎么实现的？
say.note: Claude 会读取相关代码并说明细节。

howto.what_en: When asked about a Tip line, Claude queries the live tip list, checks which tips this user can actually see, reads the feature code to verify, then explains deeply in the user's language with file paths cited.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about a Tip line, asks what a tip means or how a feature works, says “give-me-tips”, or wants to know which tips they can see.

say_en.text: What does that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: Claude will look it up and explain.

say_en.text: Which tips can I currently see?
say_en.note: Claude checks your settings and lists them.

say_en.text: How is this tip's feature actually implemented?
say_en.note: Claude reads the code and explains the mechanism.
